job.job_title: Sr. Computer Vision Engineer (Scene Intelligence and Agentic AI)
job.job_description:
Your Role

As a Sr. Computer Vision Engineer, you are the architect of the models that power the intelligence engine of our platform. You don t just train neural networks; you design sophisticated architectures where 2D DNNs, 3D Vision algorithms and Agentic AI converge to solve complex, real-world problems. You will be responsible for the end-to-end development of State-of-the-Art (SOTA) architectures for AEC use-cases that deliver superior customer outcomes in high-stakes production environments.

What We re Looking For
M Tech / PhD in Computer Science or related field from a Tier 1 university
5+ years of industry experience, incl. 3+ years in Computer Vision and Deep Learning
2+ years of leading Machine Learning (Deep Learning) projects
1+ years of leading a team of ML engineers
Experience in Agentic AI implementations with RAG, Langgraph/LlamaIndex
Experience in Natural Language Processing is a plus
Exceptional implementation experience in developing new Deep Learning models in PyTorch
Thorough understanding of software design
Previous experience in a fast-paced technology startup environment is a plus
Fluent and articulate in English
